about.title: Feedback Studios, your creative hub
about.lede: We are an all-in-one creative hub built specifically to answer every need of bands, musicians and content creators under a single roof. The space was designed to connect every stage of your project fluidly: the rooms talk to each other, letting you move from the creative immersion of a rehearsal to a multitrack audio recording, a music video shoot, a live stream or an intimate concert.

infrastructure.title: 2 dedicated rehearsal rooms
infrastructure.description: Fully equipped and ready for daily rehearsals or pre-production residencies, with one high-impact room and one balanced room for detail work.

infrastructure.title: Multi-purpose room with stage (up to 30 people)
infrastructure.description: Our big Live Room: a versatile space prepared for concert rehearsals, high-fidelity audiovisual capture and workshops.

infrastructure.title: Bar & lounge area
infrastructure.description: The ideal meeting point to relax between sessions, host guests and network with other artists and our technical team.

about.activitiesTitle: What you can do in our space

activities.title: Artist residencies & rehearsals
activities.description: Artist residency packages of up to 2 days in full immersion mode. With two independent rooms we guarantee the intensive pre-production of your project with total focus, while our ecosystem handles all the backstage logistical and technical support.

activities.title: Audio & video recording
activities.description: Simultaneous multitrack capture (drums, amplifiers and vocals) in the Multi-purpose Room, with partial acoustic isolation to keep the band's organic energy. Need more isolation? The adjacent rehearsal rooms double as secondary booths directly wired to our Central Control Room.

activities.title: Studio box: streaming, podcasts & clips
activities.description: Broadcast your concert live with real-time sound mixing and image direction, or record live sessions for later editing. Produce podcasts in a dedicated space with ATEM Blackmagic switchers, multiple cameras and studio microphones, and build dynamic music video sets using our stage, show lighting system, chroma backdrops and video mapping.

activities.title: Intimate concerts & workshops
activities.description: Exclusive showcases for album releases, acoustic concerts or private events for an audience of up to 30 people (press, brands or VIP fans), with a base technical rider (PA, professional lighting, cabling and microphones) and an open-door space for instrument masterclasses, sound technique workshops, music production and digital arts.

booking.termsIntro: By confirming a booking, I declare that:

termsItems.text: The booking corresponds to a time slot that I commit to respecting.
I commit to meeting the reserved times, including the start and end of the session.
If I cannot attend, I must cancel the booking within the notice period set by the venue's rules.
I commit to using the space and equipment responsibly and to reporting any damage or anomaly.
I accept the payment terms applicable to the booking, presented before its confirmation.
I commit to respecting the venue's rules, other users, and the established usage limits.

booking.termsFooter: By accepting these terms, I confirm that I have read and understood the conditions applicable to my booking.
booking.termsAcceptLabel: I have read and accept the Terms and Conditions.
booking.termsError: You must accept the Terms and Conditions to request the booking.

policyItems: Free reschedule up to 24 hours before the slot.
Full payment is made on rehearsal day.
Mock availability in this MVP can be replaced with real inventory later.
Final approval is handled in the backend by rehearsal staff.
